content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NCDC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 25-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NCDC Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NCDC Young Professional (Finance) posts is 25th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Young Professionals at NCDC?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for Young Professional (Finance) posts at the National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC).

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: For Young Professional-I, CA-Intermediate/ ICWA-Intermediate/ M.Com is required. For Young Professional-II, CA/ ICWA with 2 years of post-qualification experience is needed.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NCDC Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Young Professional posts is 32 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional positions?
faq.answer: Young Professional-I will receive Rs. 25,000 – 35,000 per month, and Young Professional-II will get Rs. 70,000 – 1,00,000 per month, both negotiable.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this NCDC recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the NCDC Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on academic records and experience, followed by an interview or personal discussion.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply via email by sending their complete application with all required documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the NCDC Young Professional (Finance) positions are contractual roles.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for NCDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" link.
